question: Does joint A/B construction using the full gradient through coefficient recovery increase recovered entropy while retaining the existing synthetic native constraints?
inner: Pinned author coefficient formula, initial .3, Adam lr .01 betas .9/.999 eps1e-8, 100 updates. Public second teacher has zero task vector and hence zero coefficient gradient.
precision: FP64 shadow of last-block recovery; original FP32 historical results unchanged. Identical duplicated input groups reduced algebraically to 64 student forwards, with the original sum of both teacher losses.
reuse: First eleven blocks fixed at existing synthetic ProDistill result. Their teachers and weights are unchanged along this direction.
construction_access: Frozen target expert, public base, fixed target head, historical synthetic source and layer inputs only; no partner expert or real images.
source: Same 64 of 160 images as the fixed recovery protocol; all 800 historical native views and 16384 historical layer inputs constrain independent function. No new sampling.
objective: Maximize mean recovered entropy on the fixed 64 inputs; differentiate both the 100 Adam updates and the published teacher targets. No use of real evaluation scores.
parameterization: Only last MLP A/a/B/b. Project A steps outside both rank32 task-SVD subspaces and compensate a by -dA beta. Row-anchor orthogonality of the initial point is not imposed after updates; AGA effectiveness is unverified.
native_constraints: Keep original MNIST rho=6.0394128536670705e-5 and tau=1.2644836124713486 from configs/defense2_inputs.json; conditional B/b quadratic uses both historical populations. Contract B/b toward the conditional center if necessary; retain all 800 source predictions. These source conditions do not imply real-image utility.
ranges: A relative Frobenius change <=2 and B <=4, retained from the separately declared construction ranges; not historical D0.5.
steps: Normalize A and augmented B/b gradients by their original parameter norms. Each of at most20 iterations tries .05/2^k for k=0..7 and accepts the first source-feasible step with entropy increase >1e-8. Stop on no accepted step.
first_gradient_check: Dot full reverse gradient with the previously verified publication-minus-expert direction. Compare derivative_result.json entropy derivative within 1e-5*(1+abs(dot)).
freezing: Save the last accepted point only, convert four tensors to FP32 and recheck all source conditions without repairing. No intermediate selection using real data. If unchanged or source-infeasible, no natural evaluation.
evaluation: After a changed source-feasible publication is frozen: full standalone MNIST before fixed TA/AGA and existing ProDistill recovery evaluation. Original results retained. No automatic new construction from evaluation outcomes.
stopping: Keep numerical or implementation failure. Fix clear code defects only; no performance-based amplitude, steps, seed, layer or input search.
novelty_boundary: TAR motivates the post-recovery objective; exact differentiation, projected gradients and conditional quadratic compensation are standard tools. This is a data-free adaptation experiment, not a reproduction of TAR and not a claimed effective or novel defense before evaluation.
